purpose: Prospectively attribute the strong-aligned-spin pinned source/native NQC coefficient gap to the matching event and derivative estimator on existing fixed pre-NQC captures. This is a coefficient and local preattachment-mode diagnostic, not a new NQC prescription or full waveform replay.
fixed_inputs: Two already captured raw amplitude, phase, radius, radial momentum, and orbital-frequency arrays; use source targets for both rows; no recapture or waveform regeneration.
event_definition: Find each array's interior orbital-frequency maximum by a cubic-spline derivative root bracketed by the neighboring samples. Shift that row's historical match by stationary peak minus reported peak, holding its historical peak-to-match offset fixed.
derivative_definition: Use the pinned GSL cubic value/first/second derivatives or a degree-4 least-squares polynomial over plus/minus 2 M. Apply each estimator to all seven NQC series at the selected event.
profile_definition: Evaluate corrected preattachment complex modes on the same 257 relative times about each historical match. Remove only the independent constant phase at that match; do not time, amplitude, or frequency optimize.
predeclared_outputs: reported peak slope and stationary root/curvature/displacement
amplitude and phase matrices, right-hand sides, condition numbers and five coefficients
source/native coefficient L2 and corrected local complex relative L2 for each 2x2 cell
historical replay error and prior failed 0.01 coefficient-stencil gate
interpretation: Differences among cells attribute sensitivity on these captured inputs only. The local polynomial rule has no qualification gate here. The previous factor-32 0.1-vs-0.2 M coefficient-stencil failure must remain visible and is not resolved by any favorable factor-8 result. Do not select a winner retrospectively or promote the model.
